title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for U(r) including the multiplicative constant.

title: Use of Binet's Formula
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply Binet's formula to relate the forces and the second derivative of u.

title: Correct Derivation Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student must show the correct steps in deriving the relationship between u and its derivatives.

title: Integration Process
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate the correct integration process to find U(r) from the force expression.

title: Reference Level Justification
description: Optional Criteria: The student may explain the choice of reference level for U(r) at r to infinity.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the force and potential energy expressions.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the derivation.
